description: This file defines the 'CompositeDisplayField' entity class for a Human Resource Management system, using Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping. The class extends 'AbstractDisplayField', manages a collection of 'SelectedCompositeDisplayField' instances, and includes methods for getting and setting its ID.

classes.name: CompositeDisplayField
classes.description: An entity class representing a composite display field, which contains multiple selected composite display fields and maps to the 'ohrm_composite_display_field' table in the database.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the composite display field.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the composite display field.
